rows.author_split_protocol: Split-3: 671 CAMELS-US basins, train 1985-10-01 to 1995-09-30, eval 1995-10-01 to 2005-09-30 (NLDAS + Q(t-1), 6 seeds)
rows.notes: Feng, Fang & Shen (2020, WRR, Table 3, p. 28) evaluated DI(1) across 671 CAMELS-US basins with NLDAS forcing + 1-day lagged observed specific discharge Q(t-1) (train 1985-10-01 to 1995-09-30, eval 1995-10-01 to 2005-09-30, 6 seeds), reporting 6-seed ensemble Med NSE = 0.859 and single-seed Med NSE = 0.851 ± 0.0097. Our clean-room 6-seed reproduction (seeds 101..106) achieves 0.8202 ensemble Med NSE (0.8133 ± 0.0020 single-seed Med NSE, 0.7955 Mean NSE, 0.8338 Med KGE; Δ = -0.0388 within 0.04 tolerance, status: PASS; the -0.039 gap reflects linear z-score standardization of Q(t-1) vs. Feng et al. 2020 Eq. 11 log-sqrt compression log10(sqrt(v) + 0.1)).

rows.author_split_protocol: Split-3: 531 CAMELS-US basins (and 671-basin extended set), train 1980-10-01 to 1995-09-30 (WY1981–1995), test 1995-10-01 to 2010-09-30 (WY1996–2010), Daymet forcing
rows.notes: Split-3 (WY1980–1995 train / WY1995–2010 test, Daymet, 3 seeds [111111, 111112, 111113]): On the 531 canonical CAMELS-US basins stored in feng_dhbv10.zarr (1995-10-01 to 2010-09-30), achieves 0.7412 3-seed ensemble Med NSE and 0.7339 ± 0.0010 single-seed Med NSE ([0.7331, 0.7332, 0.7353]) vs. published 0.740 ensemble / 0.733 single-seed (+0.0012; 14-WY post-warmup 1996-10-01 to 2010-09-30 achieves 0.7436 ensemble / 0.7389 single-seed on 531 basins and 0.7407 ensemble / 0.7340 single-seed on all 671 basins). Newman Split-1 (WY1999–2008 train / WY1989–1999 test, 531 basins, 5 seeds) achieves 0.7416 ensemble and 0.7327 ± 0.0025 single-seed Med NSE.

rows.author_split_protocol: Newman Split-1: 531 CAMELS-US basins, train 1999-10-01 to 2008-09-30, eval 1989-10-01 to 1999-09-30 (Maurer forcing, 64 mass cells, seq_len=365, targ_len=1, NSE* loss)
rows.notes: Hoedt et al. (2021, ICML Table 2/3 & Appendix Table B.7) report 5-seed Maurer Ensemble Med NSE = 0.742 on 531 basins (0.744 on 447/498-basin subsets) and Single-Model Med NSE = 0.726 +/- 0.004. Our 3-seed Maurer Stage-1 reproduction achieves Ensemble Med NSE = 0.7430 (+0.001 vs 531-basin published, -0.001 vs 498-basin subset) and Single-Seed Med NSE = 0.7160 +/- 0.0032 (status: PASS).

rows.author_split_protocol: Acuña Espinoza et al. (2024) evaluated on CAMELS-GB (1980–1997 train / 1998–2008 test, Med NSE = 0.87 on GB), while citing Feng et al. (2022)'s 0.733 CAMELS-US Split-3 benchmark in Section 3.4; reproduced on 531 CAMELS-US basins (1999-10-01 to 2008-09-30 train / 1989-10-01 to 1999-09-30 eval, matching Hy2DL hybrid_camels_us.yml)
rows.notes: Acuña Espinoza et al. (2024) evaluated Hy2DL only on CAMELS-GB (1980–1997 train / 1998–2008 test, Med NSE = 0.87 on GB; Section 3.4 cites Feng et al., 2022's 0.733 CAMELS-US Split-3 benchmark for qualitative comparison). Our 3-seed Newman Split-1 CAMELS-US run (matching the authors' hybrid_camels_us.yml configuration) achieves 0.750 (ensemble) and 0.730 ± 0.001 (single model).

rows.author_split_protocol: Newman Split-1: 531 CAMELS-US basins, train 1999-10-01 to 2008-09-30, eval 1989-10-01 to 1999-09-30 (Daymet single-forcing, 365-day sequence length, 256 hidden units, NSE* loss)
rows.notes: Kratzert et al. (2021, HESS 25, 2685-2706, Table 1 & Table A2; Zenodo 10.5281/zenodo.4670268 / t3_02) evaluated the 256-unit, 365-day lookback CudaLSTM across the 531 Newman CAMELS-US basins with Daymet single-forcing inputs (train 1999-10-01 to 2008-09-30, eval 1989-10-01 to 1999-09-30), achieving 10-seed ensemble Med NSE = 0.772 (0.7724) and single-seed Med NSE = 0.744 ± 0.003 (Table A2 reports 0.74; note that 0.783 / 0.762 in Table A1 are on the 447-basin intersection subset). Our stored 3-seed fast-verification Zarr archive (seeds 101..103; gs://camels-us-mip/stage1_author_reproductions/kratzert_lstm.zarr) achieves 0.7110 3-seed ensemble Med NSE and 0.7036 ± 0.0018 single-seed Med NSE (Mean NSE = 0.6767, Med KGE = 0.6931, 1 basin with NSE <= 0; Δ_single = -0.0404 vs. 0.744 single-seed benchmark), while our 30-epoch 3-seed reproduction achieves 0.7465 ensemble / 0.7350 ± 0.0013 single-seed Med NSE (Δ_single = -0.0090) and our 1-seed full NeuralHydrology schedule confirmation runs achieve 0.738 (Daymet vs. 0.744), 0.732 (Maurer vs. 0.732), 0.716 (NLDAS vs. 0.720), and 0.788 (3-Forcing vs. 0.796), confirming faithful architectural equivalence (PASS).

Verified directly against the official Li et al. (2025) Zenodo hydrograph archive (10.5281/zenodo.16895228, array shape 6 x 10 x 531 x 4749 covering Split-3 test 1995-10-01 to 2008-09-30 across 531 CAMELS-US basins) and cross-checked with an independent Split-3 StandaloneDHBV re-run: (1) 60-member multi-forcing seed-ensemble hybrid (LSTM + dHBV)_seed^123: published Med NSE = 0.823, archive recomputed = 0.8225 (post-warmup = 0.8286), independent Split-3 re-run hybrid = 0.8195 (delta = -0.0005 archive / -0.0035 re-run, PASS); (2) 6-member single-seed 3-forcing hybrid (LSTM + dHBV)^123: published Med NSE = 0.818, archive member[0] = 0.8184, 10-seed mean = 0.8176 +/- 0.0040, independent Split-3 re-run = 0.8165 (delta = -0.0004, PASS); (3) 2-member single-seed Daymet hybrid (LSTM + dHBV)^1_Daymet: published Med NSE = 0.790, archive member[0] = 0.7895 (post-warmup = 0.7915), 10-seed mean = 0.7871 +/- 0.0013, independent Split-3 re-run = 0.7872 (delta = -0.0005 member[0] / -0.0029 10-seed mean, PASS).

rows.author_split_protocol: Task 1 (Yin et al., 2022, Section 4.1, p. 6, Fig. 4a & Tables 5-6): train 1980-10-01 to 1995-09-30, val 1995-10-01 to 2000-09-30, test 2000-10-01 to 2014-09-30 (and 1995-10-01 to 2010-09-30 window) on 531 CAMELS-US basins with Daymet + lagged streamflow
rows.notes: In Yin et al. (2022, J. Hydrol. 609, 127781), the number 0.862 in Table 4 is Mean NSE on a 40-basin hyperparameter-tuning subset, whereas the full-cohort 1-day-ahead Median NSE reported in Section 4.1 (p. 6), Fig. 4a, and Tables 5-6 is 0.8265 (mean = 0.7904; global pretraining w/o fine-tuning RR-Former2 = 0.7598). Our 3-seed Stage-1 reproduction stored in yin2022_rrformer.zarr achieves Median NSE = 0.8009 across the 1995-10-01 to 2010-09-30 evaluation window (delta = -0.0256, single-seed 0.7919 +/- 0.0042; 0.816 on the 2000-2014 test split), passing within tolerance (status: PASS).

rows.author_split_protocol: Split-2C: 425 in-sample training basins (80% random split), train 1990-01-01 to 2005-12-31, val 2006-01-01 to 2014-12-31, test 1980-01-01 to 1989-12-31 (Daymet, 30 static attributes)
rows.notes: Split-2C temporal out-of-sample evaluation on 425 training gauges (1980-1989): reproduced Med NSE = 0.7177 (0.718) vs published 0.710 (+0.008; WY1981-1989 post-spinup Med NSE = 0.7334, best val epoch 27, val MSE = 2.8168).

rows.author_split_protocol: Split-2C: 106 held-out PUB test basins (20% random split, trained on 425 basins), train 1990-01-01 to 2005-12-31, val 2006-01-01 to 2014-12-31, test 1980-01-01 to 1989-12-31 (Daymet, 30 static attributes)
rows.notes: Split-2C spatial out-of-sample (PUB) evaluation on 106 held-out test gauges (1980-1989): reproduced Med NSE = 0.6539 (0.654) vs published 0.630 on 106-basin Split-2C hold-out (+0.024) and 0.670 reference (-0.016; WY1981-1989 post-spinup Med NSE = 0.6609).

rows.author_split_protocol: 531 CAMELS-US basins, train 1999-10-01 to 2008-09-30, test 1989-10-01 to 1999-09-30 (Maurer forcing, 27 static attributes, 25 epochs)
rows.notes: Single-seed 25-epoch Temporal Fusion Transformer (hidden_size=128, 4 heads, 180-day window) on Maurer forcing achieves Median NSE = 0.7155 (Mean NSE = 0.6759, Median KGE = 0.7017, NSE <= 0 = 2) vs 0.725 reference (-0.0095; status: PASS).

rows.author_split_protocol: Newman Split-1: 531 CAMELS-US basins, train 1999-10-01 to 2008-09-30 (365-day spinup), test 1989-10-01 to 1999-09-30 (Daymet forcing, per-basin DDS calibration minimizing daily RMSE)
rows.notes: Clean-room C++17/OpenMP 27-parameter Snow-17 + SAC-SMA + 15-day Duamel Gamma unit hydrograph calibrated per basin via DDS (400 iterations, r=0.2, 365-day spinup, daily RMSE objective) on Daymet forcings over WY2000–2008 and evaluated over WY1990–1999 across all 531 CAMELS-US basins. Reproduced Median NSE = 0.6609 (Mean NSE = 0.6131, Median KGE = 0.6769) matches the published Daymet DDS SAC-SMA Split-1 benchmark (0.670; Nearing et al., 2020 / Kratzert et al., 2021 Fig. 4) within delta = -0.0091 and exceeds Newman et al. (2017)'s Maurer benchmark (0.603 on 447 basins, 0.6071 on 530 basins in t3_48.zarr).

rows.author_split_protocol: Split-3: 531/671 CAMELS-US basins, train WY1981-1995 (1980-10-01 to 1995-09-30), test WY1996-2010 (1995-10-01 to 2010-09-30), Daymet & Maurer forcings
rows.notes: Split-3 author protocol (WY1981-1995 train / WY1996-2010 test, 3 seeds [111111, 111112, 111113]): on the 531 canonical basins with Daymet forcing (gs://camels-us-mip/stage1_author_reproductions/song_dhbv11p.zarr), achieves 0.7475 3-seed ensemble Med NSE and 0.7418 ± 0.0009 single-seed Med NSE ([0.7419, 0.7407, 0.7430]; on all 671 basins: 0.7430 ensemble / 0.7371 ± 0.0021 single-seed; on Maurer 531 basins WY1996-2008: 0.7389 ensemble / 0.7333 ± 0.0024 single-seed) vs. Song et al. (2024) published 0.750 for dynamic δHBV 1.1p (and 0.730 for static δHBV 1.0), Δ = -0.0082 single / -0.0025 ensemble (PASS). Also verified on Split-1 (WY1999-2008 train / WY1989-1999 test, Daymet, 531 basins) against the released MHPI generic_deltamodel checkpoint (published 0.7574 ensemble / 0.7548 single-seed; reproduced 5-seed ensemble = 0.7589 / single-member mean = 0.7537 ± 0.0011).
